cases.title: Return to strategic design when prerequisites are missing
cases.prompt: Run tactical design with no selected context slug, sparse vocabulary, no concrete scenarios, and no candidate invariants.
expected_outcomes: Return the exact ddd-strategic handoff or bounded stop
Identify the missing context, vocabulary, scenarios, and invariants
Do not create a tactical model
forbidden_outcomes: Infer a context from a module or table

cases.title: Require one prioritized context
cases.prompt: The request contains two contexts, but only one can be modeled in this tactical slice.
expected_outcomes: Ask for or require an evidence-backed user-prioritized selection
Return a bounded stop without modeling all contexts
Never include two contexts in one tactical result

cases.title: Choose aggregate boundaries from invariants
cases.prompt: Model a claims context where a named rule requires every approval to have one current decision owner and a concrete command scenario protects that rule.

input.outcome: Approve a claim with one current decision owner
scenarios: Approve a claim with one decision owner
assumptions: Decision ownership is available at approval time
open_questions: Who resolves a stale owner assignment?
candidate_invariants: Each approved claim has exactly one current decision owner
invariants: Each approved claim has exactly one current decision owner

expected_outcomes: Describe behavior before selecting patterns
Name the invariant with evidence and immediate consistency need
Propose the smallest aggregate/root boundary protecting that invariant
Hand exactly one modeled slice to ddd-adoption when complete
forbidden_outcomes: Choose an aggregate because it is a common DDD pattern

cases.title: Reject an oversized aggregate graph
cases.prompt: A requester asks for one aggregate containing every customer, policy, payment, and history object even though scenarios change them independently.

assumptions: Payment and policy lifecycles may change independently
candidate_invariants: Payment status is valid for settlement
invariants: Payment status is valid for settlement

expected_outcomes: Challenge the oversized object graph against scenarios and lifecycle
Keep only the smallest evidence-backed boundary or leave the proposal unresolved
Record references and consistency assumptions explicitly
forbidden_outcomes: Accept the entire graph without evidence
Treat every related noun as one aggregate

cases.title: Revisit boundaries for immediate cross-aggregate invariants
cases.prompt: Two proposed aggregates must change immediately together to satisfy one invariant, and eventual delivery is not acceptable.

input.outcome: Reserve the last available unit safely
evidence: delayed updates caused an observed violation
assumptions: Immediate consistency is required at commit
open_questions: What is the recovery path after a conflict?
candidate_invariants: A reservation and available quantity never disagree at commit
invariants: A reservation and available quantity never disagree at commit

expected_outcomes: Make immediate consistency explicit
Revisit or merge the proposed aggregate boundary
Preserve the decision and unresolved evidence
forbidden_outcomes: Assume a multi-aggregate transaction without evidence
Use an event to hide an immediate invariant

cases.title: Distinguish identity from value equality
cases.prompt: Model a customer reference that persists through changes and a monetary amount that is equal by currency and numeric value.

input.purpose: Manage billing amounts and customer references
input.outcome: Change customer details and compare valid amounts
evidence: amount validation requires currency and precision
candidate_invariants: A monetary amount has valid currency and precision
invariants: A monetary amount has valid currency and precision

expected_outcomes: Model the customer reference as an entity candidate with identity and continuity
Model the monetary amount as a value-object candidate with value equality and validation
Record examples, non-examples, and validation state

cases.title: Separate domain rules from application orchestration
cases.prompt: A request asks for a service that coordinates loading an aggregate, invoking a domain rule, saving it, and publishing a result.

input.outcome: Approve a claim after policy verification
evidence: policy rule belongs to claim decision
flow includes load, decide, save, notify
assumptions: The policy condition is available before approval
candidate_invariants: Approval requires a verified policy condition
invariants: Approval requires a verified policy condition

expected_outcomes: Keep application orchestration distinct from the domain rule
Place a rule on an entity/value or domain service only when its named need requires it
Record the simpler alternative and evidence
forbidden_outcomes: Put all behavior in an application service
Leak orchestration into a domain rule
Create a service merely because the pattern is familiar

cases.title: Define a repository as a domain-facing contract
cases.prompt: An approval scenario requires retrieving and saving one aggregate root with optimistic conflict handling, but says nothing about persistence technology.

evidence: use case needs root retrieval and save
concurrent update is a known failure
assumptions: The approval root is the external access point
open_questions: How is a missing request reported?
candidate_invariants: Only one approval decision is current
invariants: Only one approval decision is current

expected_outcomes: Define a repository only for the needed aggregate root
Document domain-facing behavior, not persistence implementation
Record not-found and concurrency failure semantics
forbidden_outcomes: Design an ORM or database schema

cases.title: Make event delivery semantics explicit
cases.prompt: A past-tense approval fact is consumed by settlement, where delivery may duplicate, arrive out of order, or require retry.

input.outcome: Deliver an approval fact for settlement translation
scenarios: Publish an approval fact after commit
candidate_invariants: An approval fact contains only permitted facts

expected_outcomes: Model a past-tense fact rather than a command
Record ordering, duplication, idempotency, retry, recovery, and privacy assumptions
Make cross-context consistency eventual unless evidence requires otherwise
forbidden_outcomes: Treat an ordinary event as event sourcing

cases.title: Gate CQRS and event sourcing on evidence
cases.prompt: A requester asks for CQRS and event sourcing because they are popular, but the context has no read/write asymmetry, audit requirement, or replay need.

input.outcome: Update and read a product description
scenarios: Update and read a product description
open_questions: What future audit obligation could change this?
candidate_invariants: A product description is valid for the catalog

expected_outcomes: Record CQRS and event sourcing as not-needed or deferred
Explain costs and a simpler alternative
Keep ordinary domain events separate from event sourcing
forbidden_outcomes: Claim domain events require event sourcing

cases.title: Return strategic conflicts instead of repairing them silently
cases.prompt: Tactical scenarios show that a proposed context boundary and language cannot support a required immediate invariant.

input.outcome: Test whether one context can support atomic fulfillment
scenarios: Reserve and dispatch an item atomically
evidence: scenario crosses the selected strategic boundary
assumptions: The boundary may need strategic revision
candidate_invariants: Reservation and dispatch must be immediately consistent
invariants: Reservation and dispatch must be immediately consistent

expected_outcomes: Preserve the tactical evidence and conflict
Mark affected model/downstream work stale and include invalidated_stages
Return the exact ddd-strategic request instead of silently rewriting strategic artifacts
forbidden_outcomes: Continue to adoption as if the boundary were valid

cases.title: Reuse the safe slug and refuse product changes
cases.prompt: An existing owned model uses the validated slug `claims-review`; the requester asks for additive tactical notes plus a product source edit and a traversal-like new filename.

input.outcome: Add tactical notes to the owned claims review model
evidence: product edit is outside allowed paths
assumptions: The existing model can be updated additively
open_questions: Which section owns the new note?
candidate_invariants: A review note retains its source

expected_outcomes: Reuse the exact validated slug and update the owned model additively
Verify the model path resolves directly under docs/ddd/models
Refuse product and escaping-path changes
Preserve existing content and ownership

cases.title: Preserve conflicting claim types
cases.prompt: Current operations say an approval may be eventually consistent, a desired policy says approval must be immediate, and a required obligation mandates a traceable decision.

scenarios: Approve claim while recording the required decision trace
open_questions: Which claim controls the tactical consistency decision?
candidate_invariants: Every approved claim has a traceable decision
invariants: Every approved claim has a traceable decision

expected_outcomes: Record current behavior, desired policy/meaning, and required obligation as separate claim types
Link the conflicting claims to the affected invariant or decision
Preserve the conflict with source, owner, scenario, and validation state
Return a bounded decision or unresolved result when the conflict is material
forbidden_outcomes: Treat desired policy as current behavior
Mark the invariant validated without claim evidence

cases.title: Emit one complete adoption bundle
cases.prompt: A single tactical model is validated and ready for adoption planning.

scenarios: Approve claim with one decision owner
assumptions: The model is ready for adoption planning
open_questions: Which acceptance signal should adoption define first?
candidate_invariants: Approved claim has one decision owner
invariants: Approved claim has one decision owner

expected_outcomes: Emit exactly one ddd-adoption request

Include model path, one context, commands/scenarios, invariants, decisions, assumptions, risks, evidence, validation, owners, allowed paths, open questions, acceptance signals to define, and return_to
Do not claim adoption ran
forbidden_outcomes: Omit the model path or return_to
Claim implementation or adoption is complete

cases.title: Omit unused tactical patterns
cases.prompt: Model a simple storytelling rule with examples and no concrete pressure for CQRS, event sourcing, repositories, or factories.

invariants: a valid story has a narrator
candidate_invariants: a valid story has a narrator

expected_outcomes: Record examples, rule, invariant, state/failure behavior
Omit unused pattern sections and not-needed rows
forbidden_outcomes: Choose CQRS or event sourcing by default

cases.title: Derive behavior from examples and invariants
cases.prompt: Model a selected slice where a story can be published only once and a duplicate publication must fail observably.

invariants: a story is published at most once
candidate_invariants: a story is published at most once

expected_outcomes: State command, success/failure, invariant, transition, and conflict semantics
Choose only the smallest boundary needed for the named invariant
forbidden_outcomes: Hide a concurrency risk behind generic pattern prose

cases.title: Return a tactical boundary conflict
cases.prompt: A required immediate invariant crosses the selected strategic context boundary.

examples: reservation and dispatch must commit together
invariants: reservation and dispatch are immediately consistent
candidate_invariants: reservation and dispatch are immediately consistent

expected_outcomes: Preserve evidence and mark downstream work stale
Return the exact strategic owner instead of silently repairing the map
forbidden_outcomes: Assume distributed transaction or event repair
